depiction.primary_object: calendar page outline with top tabs and header line
modifiers: closed padlock in bottom right corner
depiction.composition: single object with bottom-right badge overlay

readings.meaning: blocked time or blackout dates on calendar
private event or personal calendar privacy
code freeze or PTO blackout period

ambiguity: At small sizes, the padlock in the corner can look like a generic shopping bag, bell, or solid dot badge on a calendar.

reasoning: The icon clearly combines a calendar outline with a closed padlock badge, directly representing blocked time, blackout dates, locked schedules, or private calendar settings. While narrower than a general calendar icon, it fits common time-blocking and schedule-protection tasks well, though at tiny sizes the padlock could be confused with other corner badges like a bell.
